purpose: Replay every nonmonotonic tidal-gate topology with eight lens-geometry starts so root stability and raw-lensing leverage are measured consistently.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the tidal-gate-topology bridge fits.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing; only lens geometry, shear, centers, and source positions are reoptimized.
This is a numerical robustness replay on already inspected clusters, not an external holdout.
All 22 settings are replayed because gate topology can cross image-root boundaries.
The mixed axisymmetric-galaxy/spherical-cluster closure remains a proxy rather than a common map-based tensor theory.
